_note: Sprite animation pack with 6 creature folders, not numbered icons. Keys reference creature folder names. Each creature has Idle, Walk, Attack, Hurt, Death animation frames.
Bear: Large brown-furred bear on all fours, shaggy dark brown coat with lighter underbelly, hunched shoulders, small dark eyes
Bird: Dark gray-black crow or raven in flight, wings spread wide, orange-yellow beak, compact body with dark plumage
Bird_Stone: Stone variant of the bird, gray-brown rocky texture, carries a round boulder in talons while flying, same silhouette as normal bird
Dworf: Short stout armored dwarf warrior with iron helmet, brown leather armor, orange beard, wielding a large battle axe
Orc: Large muscular green-skinned orc with bald head, small red eye, brown leather loincloth and arm wraps, wielding a crude stone mallet on a wooden handle
Snake: Green cobra-like serpent with raised hood, olive-green scales, pale yellow underbelly, reddish-brown rattle or frill at tail tip
Yeti: Small cute white-furred yeti or abominable snowman, round body, stubby limbs, dark eyes and open mouth showing teeth, icy pale coloring
